tasks.label: Rebuild Concord map
tasks.command: $env:PYTHONPATH = (Join-Path $PWD src); python -m taxmap.cli --project examples\concord validate; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; python -m taxmap.cli --project examples\concord outlines; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; python -m taxmap.cli --project examples\concord build
